EN:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Thanks for nursing me back to
health, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}I feel like I'm
back to my old self!
You really deserve a gift, so I'll
be sending something nice to
your house, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}¡Gracias por preocuparte por mi
salud, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ya vuelvo a ser
la chica encantadora de siempre.
Voy a enviarte un regalo a casa,
cariñín.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Es lo menos que puedo
hacer, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Je ne te remercierai jamais assez de
m'avoir permis de recouvrer la
santé.
Je compte te faire un beau cadeau,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}. C'est bien la moindre
des choses.
Attends-toi à le recevoir dans ta
boîte aux lettres très bientôt,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Grazie per essere stat{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}} così
premuros{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Mi sento rinata!
Ti meriti un bel regalo, perciò
ti spedirò qualcosa di carino
a casa, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Danke, dass du dich so fürsorglich
um mich gekümmert hast!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich fühle
mich schon viel besser, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
Dafür hast du dir eine Belohnung
verdient.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ich sende dir etwas mit
der Post, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Bana bakıp iyileşmeme yardım ettiğin
için sağ ol, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Yine eski hâlime
dönmüş gibiyim!
Gerçekten bir hediyeyi hak ettin, o yüzden
evine güzel bir şey yollayacağım, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Thanks to that {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} you gave
me, I've gotten over my cold,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I've never felt better!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I truly do owe you. So I'm going to
mail you a nice gift. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Keep an
eye out for it, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Gracias a la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}que me diste,
pude deshacerme de ese resfriado,
{{TAG:0005:0008:}}. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡Me siento como nueva!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}He pensado en enviarte un regalo
a casa.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ¡Te lo mereces,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Merci encore pour le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que tu
m'as apporté. {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Je me suis
parfaitement rétablie.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je t'en suis vraiment très
reconnaissante,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} aussi je voudrais te
faire plaisir.
Attends-toi à bientôt trouver un
cadeau dans ta boîte aux lettres,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}, grazie alla {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}che mi hai dato, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}quel raffreddore
ormai è solo un brutto ricordo!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per ringraziarti, ti spedirò un regalo.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Tieni d'occhio la cassetta
della posta, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dank der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, die du mir
gebracht hast, geht es mir
wieder besser, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dafür bin ich dir wahrlich etwas
schuldig.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Ich werde dir per Post ein
Geschenk schicken, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0005:0007:}}!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bana verdiğin {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ilaç{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sayesinde
soğuk algınlığını atlattım, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hiç bu kadar iyi hissetmemiştim!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sana gerçekten borçlandım. Bu yüzden sana
güzel bir hediye postalayacağım. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Gözün
postada olsun, {{TAG:0005:0007:}}!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Thanks to you, I got over that
terrible cold. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I owe you for bringing
me that {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicine{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm going to send you something
nice I selected. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}It'll be coming
in the mail soon, I promise!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Menos mal que me trajiste esa
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, cielín. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Sin ella no me
habría recuperado nunca.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Quería compensarte, así que te
he comprado un regalo divino que
te enviaré por correo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Merci encore pour le {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}remède{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} que tu
m'as apporté.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} Je vais bien mieux,
maintenant.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pour te remercier comme il se doit,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
je compte t'envoyer un joli cadeau
très bientôt.
Alors surveille l'arrivée du facteur !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Grazie a te e alla tua {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}medicina{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}quel malanno mi è passato.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ho trovato un bel regalo
per sdebitarmi con te.
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Te lo manderò per posta!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Dir habe ich es zu verdanken, dass
ich meine Erkältung gut überstanden
habe.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Dir und der {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Medizin{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Zum Dank werde ich dir ein kleines
Geschenk per Post schicken.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Also
behalte deinen Briefkasten im Auge!
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Senin sayende o berbat soğuk algınlığını
attım. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Bana o {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ilacı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} getirdiğin için
sana borçluyum.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Özenle seçtiğim güzel bir şeyi sana
yollayacağım. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Yakında postayla gelecek, söz!
